pick.headline: US, Russia and Ukraine agree to remove Ukraine's nuclear arms
pick.summary: On January 14, 1994, Presidents Clinton, Yeltsin and Kravchuk signed a trilateral statement in Moscow under which Ukraine would give up the nuclear weapons left on its soil by the USSR.
pick.significance: The agreement settled one of the gravest proliferation risks of the Soviet collapse. Ukraine's security assurances were formalized later in the Budapest Memorandum.
